# Spell icon pack (vendored)

`public/art/spell-icons/pack.png`: a 320x128 sheet of 154 spell icons, 16px square, 20 to a row.
In game they follow the 69 classic ICON00I0 icons, so pack icon `n` is spell icon `69 + n`.

Carried with the mod author's permission (confirmed by the owner, 2026-10-30).
The mod's title and author still need adding here and to `src/ui/credits.js`.

Read by `src/ui/spell/spellIcons.js` (canvas windows) and `src/ui/enhanced/enhancedArt.js` (enhanced skin).
